title: Existence of unbounded principal quotient completion with normalized unit
statement: Let C be a site essentially small in the coefficient universe, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and t a global section. Assume countable products of R-module sheaves are exact. The principal quotient completion model [def-pur-principal-quotient-completion-model] exists: the actual quotient Roos functor has a universal left derived functor computed on every K-flat complex, together with a unit and strict quotient augmentation whose two coordinates are zero and the product of quotient maps. This assertion imposes no regularity or completeness hypothesis on t.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YT and 0941; the indicated explicit steps of lem-pur-finite-free-completion-exchange.

proof.text: Use the universal derived quotient Roos pair, computed on K-flat complexes.

Naturality of the tensor-unit inclusion and quotient cokernel maps makes the strict quotient maps natural in the input complex. Their transition identity gives the canonical Roos augmentation. Its two coordinates are zero and the product of quotient maps.

Localize this strict natural augmentation. The universal left derived counit gives a unique lift from the identity functor. The leftDerived_fac_app identity is unit_computes; the Roos augmentation coordinate theorem supplies coordinates.

proof_origin.place: Explicit refinement of the balanced quotient and resolving-class arguments in lem-pur-finite-free-completion-exchange.
